name: How do I know if an interior wall is load-bearing?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if an interior wall is load-bearing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Determining if an interior wall is load-bearing requires professional assessment. Indicators can include walls located centrally in the home, walls directly above a foundation wall or support beam in the basement, or walls running perpendicular to the floor joists in the attic or above. However, visual cues are not always conclusive. A general contractor or structural engineer can accurately identify load-bearing walls and advise on safe removal methods.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor or structural engineer can determine if an interior wall is load-bearing. Look for walls centrally located, above foundation walls, or perpendicular to floor joists, but professional assessment is necessary.
